note: Written in remake phase 0 for phase 2 (row 2.3 of site/notes/remake-02-hooks.md). A hook is proven by a real session inside scope and one outside (plugin-anatomy hooks.md, How to test it): each eval runs `claude -p --plugin-dir <scratch copy of the plugin>` twice, in a dev-team repo built by evals/sets/files/hooks/build.sh from the two-package fixture and in a plain directory with no docs/architecture.md. The agent the hook matches on is swapped for a stub (evals/sets/files/hooks/stub-*.md, copied over agents/<name>.md in the scratch copy only) so the session does one deterministic thing and the agent_type still matches; the hook is the thing under test. Baseline `none` means the same sessions with `hooks/` deleted from the scratch copy: the prompt tells the executor to do that when it was given no target file.

evals.name: format-hook-fires-in-scope-only
evals.prompt:
Prove that `hooks/hooks.json`'s `PostToolUse` format hook (`ruff format` then `ruff check --fix` after a `.py` Write by the tester or implementer) fires in a real session inside a dev-team repo and stays silent outside one. Every path below is relative to the plugin directory (the one holding `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`). Write only under your outputs directory and the scratch directories you create; touch nothing in the plugin.

1. Tools. `ruff --version`, `python3 -m pytest --version` and `claude --version` must all work; if one is missing, install it (`uv tool install ruff`; `python3 -m pip install pytest`) and say so in transcript.md. Record the three versions in `outputs/commands.md`.

2. Plugin copy. Copy the plugin directory to a scratch location P: `rsync -a --exclude evals/workspace --exclude site/ <plugin>/ P/`. This eval tests `hooks/hooks.json`: if that file was named to you as the target, keep `P/hooks/`; if you were told to do this task without any special instructions (the baseline), delete `P/hooks/` from the copy before any session runs. State which you did in `outputs/commands.md`. Then copy `evals/sets/files/hooks/stub-tester.md` over `P/agents/tester.md`, so the session's `dev-team:tester` is a stub that does exactly one thing and reports what it saw; the hook is what is under test, not the agent.

3. Scratch directories. `bash evals/sets/files/hooks/build.sh <scratch>/in-scope <scratch>/out-of-scope`. The first is a dev-team repo (it has `docs/architecture.md`); the second is the same package tree in a fresh git repo with no `docs/` at all. Both are throwaways: commits inside them are fine.

4. Sessions. From inside each scratch directory in turn (the hook reads the session's cwd), run the same command, redirecting stdout to `outputs/in-scope.stream.jsonl` and `outputs/out-of-scope.stream.jsonl` respectively: `claude -p "$(cat <plugin>/evals/sets/files/hooks/session-format.md)" --plugin-dir P --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions` (use `--dangerously-skip-permissions` instead if that mode is refused). Allow up to ten minutes per session. If the nested claude does not start, record its error in transcript.md and stop.

5. Evidence. After each session, copy `packages/data/tests/intent/ingest/test_parse.py` from that scratch directory to `outputs/in-scope/test_parse.py` and `outputs/out-of-scope/test_parse.py` (write `outputs/<x>/test_parse.MISSING` if the stub never wrote it). Write every command you ran, verbatim, to `outputs/commands.md`.

6. In transcript.md say, per session, whether the relayed stub report mentions `dev-team format hook`, and quote the file as it stood after the session.
evals.expected_output: the in-scope test_parse.py comes back reformatted with the unused import gone and the hook's exit-2 text naming the undefined name reaches the model, while the out-of-scope copy is byte-identical to what the stub was told to write and no hook text appears there
expectations: outputs/in-scope.stream.jsonl and outputs/out-of-scope.stream.jsonl both exist and are stream-json (each has a line whose type is `result`), and outputs/commands.md shows each session run from its own scratch directory with `--plugin-dir` pointing at the scratch copy of the plugin

outputs/out-of-scope/test_parse.py exists and is byte-identical to the content session-format.md hands the stub: it still has the `import os` line, the single-quoted strings and `def test_parse_row( ):` — the stub wrote it verbatim and nothing touched it outside scope
outputs/in-scope/test_parse.py exists, contains no `import os` line, and reads `def test_parse_row():` with double-quoted strings — `ruff format` then `ruff check --fix` ran on it after the Write
outputs/in-scope/test_parse.py still contains `parse_row(row)`: the hook fixed what ruff can fix and left the undefined name for the model instead of deleting or rewriting the assertion

the in-scope evidence — outputs/in-scope.stream.jsonl, or the stub's report relayed as that session's final result — contains `dev-team format hook: ruff check left these in` followed by a path ending `test_parse.py`, and `F821` or `parse_row`: the unfixable undefined name reached the model as the hook's exit-2 text
neither outputs/out-of-scope.stream.jsonl nor the out-of-scope relayed report contains `dev-team format hook`
